papers.title: Phonon Pulse Shape Discrimination in SuperCDMS Soudan
papers.summary: SuperCDMS is the next phase of the Cryogenic Dark Matter Search experiment, which measures both phonon and charge signals generated by particle recoils within a germanium target mass. Charge signals are employed both in the definition of a fiducial volume and in the rejection of electron recoil background events.
